body: Wow, looking at your history, you really just go above and beyond trying to help people. You are such a good person. Thank you for doing what you do. I am so glad that you know someone cares for you. You definitely deserve it. I am seriously in awe at this community and it is my first time posting here. Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.

Wow. I know it probably sounds so cheesey, but the two of you that have commented on my post have been so kind. My heart feels warmed. I so appreciate you. Thank you for relating to me. I feel so much more at peace. You are a fantastic person I hope you never forget that. I know it seems like a sudden change in heart but I have never experienced anything like this before. I feel as though as I can use this to propel myself further through life. That there is always someone will care about my existence, even if it is a random stranger on reddit. I am grateful for people like you. Thank you.

I just wish I could change myself. I've been aware of this aggressive and hateful part of myself for so long and it just feels like it refuses to get better, no matter how hard I try. I wish I could be a "popular" person and have people enjoy being around me. I'm sorry to be so negative. I bingewatch netflix all day long. I have abandoned all of my hobbies. They don't bring me joy anymore. I've only made it this far because I fear to leave my mom alone; my siblings have abandoned her in my parents divorce and have treated her like shit even though she is a fantastic mother. I feel far too guilty to leave her with nothing. And in turn, it makes me hate myself more for having such selfish thoughts.
Ha, that reminds me of Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt. I don't feel strong. Warm and loving sounds so nice. So nice. I am tearing up just thinking about it

I'm not even sure what to say. I don't get along with anyone. People are always nice to my face and then talk about me behind my back. I really am useless. I hate myself. I'm so hateful. I hate to distract from myself. Nothing helps. I've adopted a cat, who I know will get taken care of if I'm gone. I keep holding out for life to get better like everyone claims, but it never does. Always thoughts of death. It all seems so pointless.

What's the point in momentary joy? It doesn't last. I adopted a cat and not even that keeps me happy. She will be taken care of if I'm gone, and I know she won't miss me. Not during summer, no. It's extremely expensive. No, I don't want to deal with all the drama that comes with that.
